findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "open" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: city_room_read, city_room_members, city_room_search, city_room_dm_read, city_room_task_review, city_room_task_templates, city_room_task_comment_list · Private data: city_create_workspace, city_join_invite, city_room_read, city_room_members, city_room_search, city_room_renew, city_room_dm_read, city_room_dm_ack, city_room_dm_send, city_room_leave, city_room_post, city_room_task_claim, city_room_task_renew, city_room_task_release, city_room_task_result, city_room_task_comment_add · Public sink: city_create_workspace, city_join_invite, city_room_members, city_room_search, city_room_dm_read, city_room_dm_send, city_room_post, city_room_task_result · Destructive: city_plan_team, city_room_task_comment_delete.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
